headline: PyPI agent package compromise forces dependency audits, while new Gemini and local tools offer efficiency gains

calls.title: Audit and lock down all agent framework dependencies
calls.text: Hackers compromised the official Microsoft Agent Framework PyPI package with credential stealers. DPA must immediately audit and lock down all dependencies used in agentic workflow development.

calls.title: Test Gemini Tool Retrieval for agent efficiency
calls.text: Google released Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API to load schemas on demand. Integrate Tool Retrieval into an existing Gemini-based agent workflow with 50+ tools and compare input token costs and latency against static loading.

calls.title: Assess Sarvam-backed local coding agents in India
calls.text: Entire and Sarvam AI offer locally hosted coding agents with Indian data residency. Test coding agents on a sample internal Python data pipeline script, measuring task completion time and ensuring zero external data leakage.
